# Load all CRD data

```{r notebook opts}
FORCE_REDO <- FALSE
# FORCE_REDO <- TRUE
results_filter_fnc <- function(df) {
    df %>% 
    filter(CPM.cutoff == '3CPM') %>% 
    filter(z.score.counts) %>% 
    filter(n.SVs == NUM_SVS_TO_GENERATE) %>% 
    filter(SVs.included == NUM_SVS_TO_REMOVE)
}
FDR.line <- 
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype='dashed', color='red', linewidth=0.2)
direction.line <- 
    geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype='dashed', color='black', linewidth=0.2)
volcano.plot.elements <- 
    list(
        direction.line,
        FDR.line,
        # scale_color_viridis_c(alpha=0.5),
        labs(x='Test Statistic', y='-log10(p-value)')
    )
```
Load all merged CRDs
```{r load_merged_CRDs}
add_merge_origin_annotations <- function(df){
    df %>% 
    left_join(
        all.merged.CRDs.df,
        by=
            intersect(
                colnames(df),
                colnames(all.merged.CRDs.df)
            )
    )
}
all.merged.CRDs.df <- 
    list_all_results_files_in_set(set.name='merged.CRDs') %>% 
    results_filter_fnc() %>% 
    filter(merging.level != 'separate') %>% 
    mutate(
        CRDs=
            future_pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=combine_CRD_Locations_and_PeakLists,
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    unnest(CRDs) %>% 
    select(
        CPM.cutoff, residual.model, AD.definition.column,
        z.score.counts, n.SVs, SVs.included,
        sample.strategy, meanClusterSize, merging.level,
        is.decorate.filtered,
        CRDID, detected.in.groups
    ) %>% 
    mutate(CRD.sample.strategy=sample.strategy)
```
Load differential CRD statistics
```{r load_all_differential_stats}
all.differential.CRD.results.df <- 
    check_cached_results(
        results_file=ALL_CRD_DIFFERENTIAL_STATS_TSV_FILEPATH,
        force_redo=FORCE_REDO,
        # force_redo=TRUE,
        results_fnc=
            function() {
                list_all_results_files_in_set(set.name='CRD.differential.stats') %>%
                mutate(
                    diff.stats=
                        future_pmap(
                            .l=list(filepath),
                            .f=read_tsv,
                            show_col_types=FALSE,
                            .progress=TRUE
                        )
                ) %>%
                unnest(diff.stats) %>%
                filter(nPeaks >= 5) %>% 
                # count CRDs per pre-merged origin grouping
                group_by(
                    CPM.cutoff, residual.model, CRD.sample.strategy,
                    z.score.counts, n.SVs, SVs.included,
                    meanClusterSize, is.decorate.filtered,
                    contrast, method,
                    detected.in.groups
                ) %>% 
                mutate(nCRDs=length(unique(CRDID))) %>%
                ungroup(detected.in.groups) %>% 
                mutate(
                    log10.p.value=-log10(p.value),
                    p.adjust=p.adjust(p.value, method='BH'),
                    log10.p.adjust=-log10(p.adjust)
                ) %>% 
                ungroup()
            }
    ) %>% 
    filter(
        contrast %in% 
            c(
                "sex-Male-Female",
                # "Biobank-Rush-MSBB",
                # "Braak_3levels-Braak_5plus-Braak_Max2",
                "Braak_3levels-Braak_5plus-Braak_3to4",
                "CDR_3levels-Dementia-Healthy",
                "age-NA-NA",
                "AD_CERAD_withDLB-AD-Control"
            )
    ) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>% 
    select(-c(count, filepath))
```

# Total CRD Size and Coverage

Here I plot the total size and coverage of all CRDs in the genome across each set of CRDs estimated.
```{r make_CRD_counts_data}
#| eval: false

stat.vars <- 
    c(
        "CRD.length",
        "CRD.nPeaks",
        'peak.length-total'
    )
CRD.counts.df <- 
    all.CRD.features.df %>%
    filter(CRD.feature %in% stat.vars) %>% 
    select(-c(CRD.feature.type)) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from=CRD.feature, values_from=CRD.value) %>% 
    group_by(across(-all_of(c('CRDID', stat.vars)))) %>% 
    summarize(
        .groups='drop',
        nCRDs=dplyr::n(),
        CRD.length=sum(CRD.length),
        CRD.nPeaks=sum(CRD.nPeaks),
        `peak.length-total`=sum(`peak.length-total`)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        CRD.density=1e6 * CRD.nPeaks / CRD.length,
        CRD.peak.coverage=100 * `peak.length-total` / CRD.length
    ) %>% 
    pivot_longer(
        all_of(c(stat.vars, 'nCRDs', 'CRD.density', 'CRD.peak.coverage')),
        names_to='CRD.feature',
        values_to='CRD.value'
    )
```

# Plot distributions of CRD features across all merged CRDs

```{r pairplot_wrapper}
make_pairplot <- function(
    freq.df,
    group.colname='feature.name',
    value.colname='CRD.value',
    color.colname='sample.strategy',
    linewidth=0.2,
    text.size=7,
    alpha=0.5,
    ...){
    plot.df <- 
        freq.df %>% 
        pivot_wider(
            names_from=!!sym(group.colname),
            names_prefix='group_',
            values_from=!!sym(value.colname),
        )
    cols.to.plot <- grep('^group_', colnames(plot.df), value=TRUE)
    if (!is.na(color.colname)) {
        maps <- aes(color=.data[[color.colname]], alpha=alpha)
    } else {
        maps <- aes(alpha=alpha)
    }
    ggpairs(
        plot.df,
        mapping=maps,
        columns=cols.to.plot,
        columnLabels=str_remove(cols.to.plot, '^group_'),
    ) +
    geom_abline(
        intercept=0,
        slope= 1,
        linewidth=linewidth,
        color='black',
        linetype='dashed'
    ) +
    geom_abline(
        intercept=0,
        slope=-1,
        linewidth=linewidth,
        color='black',
        linetype='dashed'
    ) +
    geom_vline(
        xintercept=0,
        linewidth=linewidth,
        color='black',
        linetype='solid'
    ) +
    geom_hline(
        yintercept=0,
        linewidth=linewidth,
        color='black',
        linetype='solid'
    ) +
    theme(
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=text.size),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=text.size),
        strip.text=element_text(size=text.size+1)
    ) + 
    make_ggtheme()
}
```

# Quantile-Quantile Plots for CRD p-values across contrasts and conditions

Does the cross-sample merging 
```{r compute_pvalue_quantiles}
#| eval: false

CRD.pvalues.df <- 
    all.differential.CRD.results.df %>% 
    select(
        CPM.cutoff, residual.model, CRD.sample.strategy, contrast, CRDID, detected.in.groups, method,
        log10.p.adjust, log10.p.value
    ) %>% 
    # select(CPM.cutoff, residual.model, CRD.sample.strategy, contrast, CRDID, detected.in.groups, method, p.adjust, p.value) %>% 
    pivot_longer(
        c(log10.p.adjust, log10.p.value),
        # c(p.adjust, p.value),
        names_to='CRD.metric',
        values_to='CRD.value'
    )
CRD.quantiles.df <- 
    bind_rows(
        CRD.pvalues.df %>% 
            select(-c(detected.in.groups)) %>% 
            mutate(detected.in.groups=CRD.sample.strategy),
        CRD.pvalues.df %>% filter(CRD.sample.strategy == 'merged')
    ) %>% 
    group_by(across(-all_of(c('CRDID', 'CRD.value')))) %>%
    summarize(
        quantiles=
            quantile(CRD.value, probs=seq(0, 1, 0.02)) %>% 
            enframe(name='quantile') %>% 
            mutate(quantile=fct_reorder(quantile, row_number())) %>% 
            list()
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    unnest(quantiles)
```

```{r plot_CRD_p_quantiles, results='asis'}
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        # 'residual.model'
        'residual.model', 'method', 'CRD.metric'
    )
CRD.quantiles.df %>% 
    filter(CRD.sample.strategy == detected.in.groups) %>% 
    select(-c(CRD.sample.strategy)) %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    # nest(plot.df=-all_of(c(nesting.vars))) %>% 
    nest(freq.df=-all_of(c(nesting.vars))) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=make_pairplot,
                color.colname='contrast',
                group.colname='detected.in.groups',
                value.colname='value',
                linewidth=0.2,
                text.size=7,
                alpha=0.5,
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=2,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )
```

# Plot CRD features stratified by CRD detection set (AD/Control/Both)

## Stratified CRD feature distributions

Now we can plot the distributions of various CRD features across all CRDs, stratified by the merge origins.
```{r plot_stratified_CRD_features, results='asis'}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 12
# #| eval: false

# Now plot correlation of SVs across datasets
nesting.vars <- 
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        'residual.model'
        # 'AD.definition.column',
    )
# OCR.summary.stats.df %>% head(1) %>% t()
# OCR.summary.stats.df %>% count(CRD.feature.type, feature, summary.stat)
# OCR.summary.stats.df %>% count(sample.strategy, meanClusterSize, merging.level)
OCR.summary.stats.df %>% 
    filter(summary.stat != 'total') %>% 
    filter(meanClusterSize == 'merged') %>% 
    filter(sample.strategy == 'merged') %>% 
    add_merge_origin_annotations() %>% 
    inner_join(
        tribble(
            ~feature,              ~feature.name,             
            'gene.length',         'mean Assoc. Gene Length (bp)',
            'peak.length',         'mean OCR Length (bp)',
            'peak.distanceToTSS',  'mean OCR dist to TSS (bp)',
            'CRD.length',          'CRD Size (bp)',
            'CRD.nPeaks',          'CRD Size (# OCRs)',
            'CRD.peak.coverage',   '% CRD Covered by OCRs',
        ) %>% 
        mutate(feature.name=fct_reorder(feature.name, row_number())),
        by='feature'
    ) %>% 
    select(-c(feature, CRD.feature.type, summary.stat)) %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    mutate(detected.in.groups=str_remove_all(detected.in.groups, '.Samples')) %>% 
    nest(plot.df=-all_of(c(nesting.vars))) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=plot_boxplot,
                x.var='detected.in.groups',
                y.var='CRD.value',
                fill.var='detected.in.groups',
                facet.group='feature.name', facet.nrow=2,
                outliers=FALSE,
                outlier.size=1,
                legend.position='none',
                axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1),
                scales='free', independent='y',
                y.scale.mode='m', y.axis.label.accuracy=0.01,
                axis.title=element_blank(),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=3,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )
```

## Stratified CRD-level differential stats

```{r plot_stratified_CRD_differential_summaries, results='asis'}
#| echo: false

nesting.vars <- 
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        'residual.model'
        # 'AD.definition.column',

# all.differential.CRD.results.df %>% count(CRD.sample.strategy, contrast, method)
all.differential.CRD.results.df %>% 
    filter(CRD.sample.strategy == 'merged') %>% 
    pivot_longer(
        c(p.adjust, p.value, log10.p.adjust, log10.p.value),
        names_to='metric',
        values_to='value'
    ) %>% 
    filter(
        metric %in%
            c(
                # p.value,
                'log10.p.value',
                # p.adjust,
                'log10.p.adjust'
            )
    ) %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    mutate(detected.in.groups=str_remove_all(detected.in.groups, '.Samples')) %>% 
    nest(plot.df=-all_of(c(nesting.vars))) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=plot_boxplot,
                x.var='detected.in.groups',
                y.var='value',
                fill.var='detected.in.groups',
                facet.col='contrast', facet.row=c('method', 'metric'),
                scales='free_y',
                legend.position='none',
                plot.elements=list(FDR.line),
                axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1),
                axis.title=element_blank(),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=2,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )
```

## Stratified OCR ~ CRD differential Comparison

```{r plot_stratified_OCR_vs_CRD_differential_stats, results='asis'}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 10
#| eval: false

OCR.level.data.df <- 
    all.CRD.differential.stats.df %>%
    filter(contrast == 'AD_CERAD_withDLB') %>%
    dplyr::rename('OCRs.value'=CRD.value)
CRD.level.data.df <- 
    all.differential.CRD.results.df %>% 
    filter(contrast %in% c('AD_CERAD_withDLB-AD-Control', 'age-NA-NA')) %>% 
    dplyr::rename('CRD.contrast'=contrast) %>%
    select(-c(seqnames, start, end, width, strand, nPeaks, stats, nCRDs, p.value, p.adjust, sign)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
        c(log10.p.adjust, log10.p.value),
        names_to='CRD.metric',
        values_to='CRD.value'
    ) %>% 
    # mutate(CRD.metric=glue('{method} {CRD.metric}')) %>%
    select(-c(CRD.sample.strategy))
plot.df <- 
    inner_join(
        CRD.level.data.df,
        OCR.level.data.df,
        by=
            intersect(
                colnames(CRD.level.data.df),
                colnames(OCR.level.data.df)
            )
    ) %>%
    filter(sample.strategy == 'merged')
nesting.vars <- 
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        'residual.model',
        'CRD.metric'
    )
plot.df %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    nest(plot.df=-all_of(c(nesting.vars))) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=plot_jitter,
                regression_fnc=lm,
                y.var='OCRs.value',
                x.var='CRD.value',
                color.var='detected.in.groups',
                size=1, alpha=0.5,
                # facet.col='OCR.metric', 
                # facet.row=c('CRD.contrast'),
                facet.row=c('metric', 'summary.stat'),
                facet.col=c('CRD.contrast', 'CRD.metric'),
                scales='free',
                # legend.position='none',
                axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1),
                axis.title=element_blank(),
                plot.elements=
                    list(
                        geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype='dashed', color='red', linewidth=0.2),
                        geom_vline(xintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype='dashed', color='red', linewidth=0.2)
                    ),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=2,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )
```
